programs.title: Treasures Decoded
programs.desc: The creators of the series conduct archaeological investigations into unsolved mysteries of antiquity.The emergence of new evidence gives researchers further opportunities to solve each of them.In each episode, world-class experts from various fields focus on a different archaeological object and search for the truth about its origin.Viewers will learn the latest scientific theories, dramatic stories and surprising answers about the real Tower of Babel, the Egyptian plagues, Stonehenge and the city of Petra.

programs.title: Eden: Untamed Planet
programs.desc:
Documentary filmmakers go to the most remote corners of our planet to discover the secrets of the few untouched ecosystems.From the Namib Desert to Patagonia, only a few places on Earth have remained largely unchanged.Isolated from the rest of the world, they managed to defend themselves against the most harmful effects of human interference.Life there goes on as nature intended.The creators will take viewers on an exciting journey to the last places that are paradise on earth.Amazing, breathtaking landscapes will be presented, as well as exciting behaviors of the most popular animals in the world.Each episode will feature a different unique corner of the globe - from the mysterious, fog-shrouded forests of Borneo to the lush beauty of Africa's Luangwa floodplain
The tropical island of Borneo is located in the heart of Southeast Asia.Its area is as large as the US state of Texas, and its forests have remained unchanged for 140 million years.Areas bathed in sunlight are cooled by heavy rainfall.Such greenhouse conditions resulted in the development of approximately 60,000 species of plants and animals there over time.In terms of biology, this island is one of the most diverse.Over 6,000 endemic species have evolved here in isolated conditions.The extraordinary wealth of nature arises from shallow, nutrient-poor soil.However, life managed to triumph here, transforming this place into a unique paradise on earth.
